description: Authored examine replies for the named opening grass and silence.

replacements.old:
<ROUTINE HOUSE-FOUNDATION-STONE-F ()
	<COND (<VERB? EXAMINE>
	       <TELL "Old foundation stone shows where the painted wall gives way to weeds and the darker edge of the forest. It is part of the house, not a loose rock." CR>)
	      (<VERB? TAKE>
	       <TELL "The foundation is still doing the work of holding the house up." CR>)
	      (T <RFALSE>)>>

<ROUTINE SURFACE-SONGBIRD-F ()

<ROUTINE FIELD-GRASS-F ()
	<COND (<VERB? EXAMINE>
	       <TELL "The grass has gone a little wild around the house. It is ordinary field grass, not a path and not a hiding place." CR>)
	      (<VERB? TAKE>
	       <TELL "A handful of grass comes up and means nothing. The field stays." CR>)
	      (T <RFALSE>)>>

<ROUTINE FIELD-SILENCE-F ()
	<COND (<VERB? EXAMINE LISTEN>
	       <TELL "The silence has the settled quality of a place left alone too long. It is the field, not an object you can pocket." CR>)

	       <TELL "Silence is not a takeable thing." CR>)
